name: error-bell
description: Plays a sound alert when terminal commands fail. Stay focused — get instantly notified of build failures, test errors, and script crashes without watching the terminal.

errorBell.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Error Bell sound on terminal command failure.

errorBell.sound.markdownDescription: The sound to play on error. Use `Error Bell: Select Sound` from the Command Palette to choose or add custom sounds.
enumDescriptions: Pick randomly from system sound and all your custom sounds

errorBell.volume.description: Playback volume for error sounds (0 = mute, 100 = max). Use 'Error Bell: Set Volume' to change.

errorBell.cooldown.description: Minimum seconds between error sounds. Prevents spam when a script fails repeatedly in a loop. Set to 0 to disable.

errorBell.ignoredExitCodes.description: Exit codes that should never trigger the error sound. Default: [130] (Ctrl+C). Common additions: 1 (grep no match, git diff), 2 (misuse of shell built-ins).

errorBell.quietHoursStart.description: Start of quiet hours in 24h format (e.g. 22:00). Leave empty to disable quiet hours.

errorBell.quietHoursEnd.description: End of quiet hours in 24h format (e.g. 08:00). Leave empty to disable quiet hours. Supports overnight ranges (e.g. 22:00 to 08:00).

errorBell.successSound.markdownDescription: Sound to play when a terminal command exits successfully (exit code 0). Leave empty to disable. Set to `SystemSound` for the OS default, `Random` to pick randomly from your `sounds-success` folder, or paste an absolute path to a specific file.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && mocha --ui tdd out/test/**/*.test.js
